title: Перевести conformance на successor и выпустить integrated P6 gate
summary: Подключить PHP/Dart/reference adapters и Agentools harness к `2026-09`, собрать candidate revision lock и единый P6 receipt с раздельными Agentools/JCS/official-MCP секциями.
why: Individual green profiles/oracles/scenarios do not prove the successor is consumable end to end. The phase must close only when revision, adapters, case coverage, parity and external applicability agree on one tree. `RAG:—`.

include: Successor adapter negotiation; migrated/new behavior vectors; rule/case coverage; manifests/spec_rev bump; reference/PHP/Dart reports; candidate digest lock; local four-layer gate integration; immutable `2026-08` regression; semantic/JCS/MCP receipt aggregation without merged pass rate; residual ownership for P7–P10.
exclude: Public tag/freeze/upload; changing P2–P5 contract meaning; P7 export/layout; P8 mutation/fuzz/performance depth; P9 workflow permissions/SBOM/provenance; P10 release acceptance; hiding non-applicable or blocked official MCP rows; editing generated reports by hand.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Adapters declare `2026-09` and reject revision mismatch. The candidate lock is generated after all normative/generated successor artifacts are fresh and records digests, not a git tag. Aggregate report reuses child receipts by digest and keeps three namespaces: `agentools`, `jcs_oracle`, `mcp_official`; it never sums them into one percentage. Every applicable check must pass; `blocked_dependency` stays non-green; `non_applicable` requires reason. `tools/ci_gate.py` may add local checks but not P9 release credentials/permissions. Existing `2026-08` bytes/tag/report readability stay intact. Reports and locks are generated only by their owners.
guidance: Parameterize revision-specific literals instead of scattering a second hard-coded string. Preserve historical reports. Make the gate print exact commands, input digests, counts and output paths. Residual rows name one owner P7/P8/P9/P10 and never reopen P2–P5 silently.
deliverables: Successor-aware Agentools conformance, digest-bound candidate revision lock, integrated P6 gate/receipts and explicit P7–P10 residual handoff.
